purpose: Source registry for accessibility examples and local-model evaluation data.

collection_policy.split_rule: split by source, page family, and template; never split near-duplicate good/bad variants
collection_policy.training_artifacts: store provenance and hashes; do not silently redistribute source material

sources.notes: Project-owned authored pages and captured NVDA fixtures; keep these as regression data, not the only holdout.
Author fresh paired pages from the guidance and capture them locally. Preserve attribution and check W3C reuse terms before redistributing copied material.
JSON metadata includes expected outcome and WCAG mappings. Recapture only cases observable by this NVDA pipeline.
Before/after versions of several pages with evaluation reports; use for validation and avoid treating it as the sole training source.
Functional patterns provide good examples. Generate and label one known mutation at a time, then capture with NVDA.
